text: 从她空洞凝视的双眼和曾经赤褐色、如今夹杂白发的头发，你意识到西尔维娅已被折磨得彻底疯狂。雪怪把她像真人大小的玩偶一样挪来挪去，放在岩棚下你身旁。她对你的沟通尝试毫无反应。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 351
text: By the vacant look in her staring eyes, by the white streaks in her once-auburn hair, you realize that Sylvia has gone quite mad from her ordeal. The sasquatches move her around camp like a life-sized doll, placing her beside you under a rock overhang. She ignores your attempts at communication.
